name: Nine☆Lives ~Hanyafuda Suru Nyan!~
original_name: ないん☆らいぶす 〜はニャ札するにゃん！〜
source:
This is a majong like tile matching game. In the Story mode, our guy found a were-cat that used one of her spare lives to save him. He still has to collect 8 more lives in order not to be turned into a zombie. That and a weird gem makes his life exciting. In the Tournament mode, you can pick one of 8 girls to play with.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
本作是一款类似麻将的牌块配对游戏。故事模式中，主人公遇见一名猫人少女，她耗费一条备用性命救了他。为了不变成僵尸，他还必须收集另外八条性命。一块奇怪宝石也让他的生活越发热闹。大会模式则可从八名女孩中选择一人进行游戏。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
